title: perfect size for daily use
text:
perfect size for daily use. Ooo.. I love love this size of pyrex bowl with lip edge. They are so hard to find separate from sets with other sized bowls and worth every penny. I use them for soup, salad, soba noodles, etc... pretty much everything because they are the perfect size for me. Dishwasher safe, of course... microwave with worry of plastic poison...and even oven safe. Store leftovers, fridge or freezer. Stack with ease. Yup. They are my go-to use, every day! They are clear... with a teeny tiny hint of blue/green? When you use to heat in the microwave that outer edge is hot, but you can still grip it to get it out. Handy.
They arrived VERY well packed with bubblewrap, in boxes with packing as well. Super fast, I have prime. I will update with any wear/use issues, but I don't expect any!
UPDATE: 11/2015.... no problems to report... they are standing up as predicted, perfect for the dishwasher.
